payload.title: Gate-14 实验：稳定化/开环训练/DirectNN/闭环控制代理/实时性

payload.gate14A: d_M grows 0.19->1.45, corr with RMSE 0.49-0.57; open-loop training reduces defect and error 0.287->0.037.
payload.gate14B: Budgeted low-rank + rho<=0.99 does NOT rescue propagation (R_prop 0.368->1.568); open-loop (scheduled) training rescues it (0.368->0.041) even without rho penalty.
payload.direct_nn: DirectNN H20 0.2596 vs Koopman 0.0439 at equal params.
payload.gate14C: Closed-loop proxy (plant=DirectNN): C1 frozen fails (0.2135 vs 0.136); C0~C2 (~3% gain).
